chunks: Ḥarīz narrated from al-Fuḍayl, who said:

Al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about an infant that falls from his mother without crying out—does he inherit? He turned away from him, and when he repeated it to him, he said: “If he moves with clear movement, he is given inheritance, for he may perhaps have been mute.”

key_terms.أَخْرَسَ: mute; unable to cry out or speak
key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the infant or newborn in question

ai.seo_question: Does a newborn who does not cry at birth inherit in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the inheritance of a newborn who does not cry at birth. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that if the child shows clear movement, the child inherits, since the absence of a cry does not necessarily mean absence of life and the child may simply be mute.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5661 - Hariz narrated from Al-Fudayl who said:

Al-Hakam ibn Utaibah asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a child who is born from his mother without letting out a cry - does he inherit?
Imam (as) turned away from him. When he repeated the question, Imam (as) said:
"If the child moves with clear movement, he inherits, for it is possible that he may be mute."
